meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 为 NanoClaw 添加监控仪表盘并推送数据快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 NanoClaw 并需要可视化运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard and push data snapshots to NanoClaw
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and need to visualize its runtime status

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 安装一个本地监控仪表盘,可查看代理组、会话、渠道、用户、token 用量、上下文窗口、消息活动和实时日志。同时添加一个推送模块,定期把 JSON 快照发给仪表盘。
howto.when: 当你说要加监控仪表盘/面板时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加个监控仪表盘
say.note: Claude 随即执行安装步骤。

say.text: 帮我配上 dashboard 面板

howto.what_en: Installs a local monitoring dashboard for NanoClaw, displaying agent groups, sessions, channels, users, token usage, context windows, message activity, and real-time logs. Adds a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Claude will start installing and configuring it.
Installs the package and edits config.

say_en.text: Set up the dashboard panel for me
